content.short: Genesis Auction House is a secure, smart-contract-based NFT marketplace for verified collections on Cardano.
content.description: Genesis Auction House is one of the premier NFT marketplaces on the Cardano blockchain, prioritizing security and trustless transactions through smart contracts. The platform hosts over 1,000 verified collections, offering users a safe environment to buy, sell, and auction their digital assets. With support for major wallets like Nami, Genesis enables fast and efficient listings while ensuring that creator royalties are respected for every secondary sale. By combining technical reliability with a user-friendly interface, it serves as a vital hub for both artists and collectors.
content.meta: Genesis Auction House is a Cardano NFT marketplace with smart-contract security and verified art. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
